sign_convention: curve_ft and offline_ft: negative = left, positive = right (right-handed golfer view). curve = how much the ball bent in the air; offline = where it finished relative to the target line.

coaching_notes: Steady club speed but erratic contact, with thin and topped PW shots (launch as low as 1.7°, carry as short as 9 yds).
Swing video: arms-dominant swing with little body rotation, a steep, handsy downswing and a short, cut-off finish.

coaching_notes: No thin or topped shots across 36 swings (lowest launch 18°).
Launch runs high on every iron, which points to adding loft at impact.
The miss moves farther right as the club gets longer: the PW is centered, but the 5hy averages about 28 yds right and starts right before curving, which suggests an open clubface.
